metadata.title: Ordinance on Clinical Trials with the exception of Clinical Trials of Medical Devices (Clinical Trials Ordinance, ClinO / KlinV), SR 810.305
metadata.edition: SR 810.305 · Arts. 40–43 (safety reporting) · Art. 41 read in German on the droit-bilingue.ch de-en mirror (unofficial, pre-2024 consolidation, no Stand). Revised ordinance in force 1 November 2024 not read
metadata.legal_basis: SR 810.305 · Arts. 40–43 (safety reporting) as in force; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
